events.headline: US STRIKES THREE IRANIAN CRUDE OIL TANKERS (VIDEO)
events.detail: The US Central Command has reported attacking three Iranian oil tankers in the latest flare-up in the Gulf Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: US AND IRAN TRADE RETALIATORY ATTACKS ON SHIPS AS CONFLICT FLARES
events.detail: The US says it hit three Iranian oil tankers, while Iran says it targeted three US-linked ships.

events.headline: EE.UU. ATACÓ TRES PETROLEROS IRANÍES CERCA DE LA ESTRATÉGICA ISLA DE KHARG
events.detail: Las fuerzas norteamericanas dijeron haber atacado los buques tanque en represalia por un ataque con misiles contra navíos de guerra de EE.UU.

events.headline: US SAYS IT HIT THREE IRANIAN OIL TANKERS AFTER ATTACKS ON WARSHIPS
events.detail: US Central Command says its forces struck three Iranian crude oil carriers on Saturday.

events.headline: ESTADOS UNIDOS BOMBARDEA TRES PETROLEROS IRANÍES, UNO DE ELLOS CERCA DE LA ESTRA
events.detail: Según Washington, la República Islámica lanzó previamente misiles contra dos buques de guerra que patrullaban en la zona
